lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters are arranged in approximately three to four irregular vertical columns posterior to the branchial region, following the lateral curvature of the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance spots, forming a faint grid-like pattern posterior to the gill slits.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature runs horizontally across the upper third of the visible flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with high luminance on the dorsal side and a distinct shadow on the ventral side.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Two dark, slender, elongated appendages (likely remoras or external parasites) are visible: one near the subterminal mouth region and another attached to the posterior-ventral margin of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A dense, high-frequency constellation of small white spots is visible on the dorsal surface of the cranial region, contrasting with the larger, more widely spaced spots on the lateral flank.
